name: PS One Shot
author: misza-one
description: A DualSense as the controller for Hyprland and your AI agents: radial menus, push-to-talk dictation, adaptive triggers, a lightbar that shows who waits. The bar widget shows the controller's battery and, per machine, your agents by status. Needs the PS One Shot daemon (install.sh).

barWidget.description: DualSense battery, and per machine how many agents wait, are done, work or idle, coloured like the lightbar. Click for the agents, middle-click for the carousel, right-click to pause the controller.

schema.label: Machine labels
schema.description: What stands before each machine's counts: its hostname up to the first dot, its first letter, or nothing (a gap still separates the machines).

schema.label: Count idle agents
schema.description: Show how many agents sit idle, faded. Off, the bar counts only agents that wait, are done or work.
